Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.engine

Class ChaosGameDescriptionFactory

java.lang.Object
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.engine.ChaosGameDescriptionFactory
public class ChaosGameDescriptionFactory extends Object
A factory class for creating predefined ChaosGameDescription instances. This class provides static methods to generate descriptions for well-known fractals, such as the Sierpinski Triangle and the Barnsley Fern, as well as a method to generate a description for Julia sets given a specific complex number.
Since:
0.0.3 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)

    • createJuliaSetDescription

      public static ChaosGameDescription createJuliaSetDescription(Complex c, int order)
      Generates a ChaosGameDescription for creating a Julia set fractal based on a given complex number. The method configures transformations that apply the Julia set iteration based on the specified complex constant. The bounds for this fractal are set to commonly used values for Julia sets, but may need adjustment based on the characteristics of the specific set being generated.
      Parameters:
      c - The complex constant used in the Julia set transformation.
      order - The order of the Julia set (e.g., 2 for a standard Julia set, 3 for cubic Julia set).
      Returns:
      A ChaosGameDescription instance configured for a Julia set based on the given constant and order.
      Since:
      0.0.0
